answer: oasis seats a basalt only with countersignature from every chamber in its fixed set, and a chamber signs only an entry that burns more pigment than that chamber has ever burned, so its burn total doubles with each signature. The k-th basalt in a chamber therefore burns twice the last, read and incremented atomically at commit, so parallel and batched entries cannot share or pre-empt a price. A thousand clones spread over the fixed chambers pay exponentially, in pigment attached to each seat. It breaks if oasis admits new chambers or allows a chamber to fork.
